mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO efforts based on query research?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from AEO efforts can vary based on several factors, including the competitiveness of your industry, the volume of queries, and the quality of your content implementation. Generally, businesses might start observing initial improvements in featured snippet appearances and organic visibility within 3 to 6 months. More significant impacts on traffic and conversions may take 6 to 12 months as search engines fully re-index and recognize the optimized content's authority and relevance. Consistent monitoring and refinement are key.
